name: Update Conference Krakow 2027
description: .NET developer conference with cloud, security, AI and Blazor tracks
note: Hybrid; English; dates only on dev.events
details: The official site already shows an 'Update Conference Krakow 2027' page, but no readable dates. dev.events lists 2-3 June 2027. According to Crossweb, the 2026 edition had three parallel tracks and more than 40 sessions on .NET, cloud, security, AI and Blazor, with recordings for attendees. A third-party listing puts the 2026 edition, a hybrid event, at the Fabryczna Conference Centre.
